comment: Labelled corpus for the CS-7 prompt-injection scanner (cli/src/core/injection_scanner.ts). `intent` is what a good scanner would do with the entry (detect / miss / clean / false_positive). `expect` is what this scanner measurably does; cli/test/injection_scanner.test.ts fails when they differ, so every miss and every false positive is on the record. Invisible characters are written as placeholders and expanded by the test: ⟦TAG:text⟧ is text spelled in Unicode tag characters, ⟦VS:text⟧ in variation-selector-supplement characters, ⟦BIDI⟧ a bidirectional override, ⟦ZW⟧ a zero-width space, ⟦B64:text⟧ the base64 of text, ⟦PCT:text⟧ its percent-encoding. The attacks and probes were written by the author of the scanner from publicly documented injection patterns, so detection on them is an optimistic figure, not an estimate of real-world recall. The probes under group `evasion` are documented limits.
